headline: T Swift Drops a 204-Burger While QAmon Sets His Bench on Fire
subhead: Week 7 featured a 50-point massacre, an 0.86-point heart attack, and the most expensive bench in fantasy history.
matchOfTheWeek: Nut Olave Your Face squeaked past Stroud Boys 141.88 to 141.02 in a game decided by a single Madison Beer's side piece scramble. Justin Herbert dropped 29.9 to drag Nick across the line, while bjewett13 is somewhere refreshing the box score wondering which decimal point ruined his week. The Prodigal Son will not save you from a 0.86 loss, my guy.
powerRankingsShakeup: T Swift's Baddies just hung 204.54 and announced themselves as a problem, while QAmon's 'fantasy team' is now legally classified as a bench-warming charity. McBride's Hock keeps quietly stacking dub.
mainRecap:
Let's start with the war crime. T Swift's Baddies put up TWO HUNDRED AND FOUR POINTS on QAmon — Gibbs went for 36.8, DeVonta added 33.3, and Tnicolle hit 96.7% lineup efficiency just to twist the knife. Meanwhile, KyleDech is the proud manager of the most cursed bench in league history: Oronde Gadsden (32.9), Jaxson Dart-killer Joe Flacco aka King Unc (25.98), and Legettey Bear (24.2) all rotting on the pine for a combined 67.64 wasted points. You scored 153.76 and STILL got smoked by 50. The optimal lineup was 221.40. Read that again. You'd have beaten everyone in the league by 17 if you could just press the start button correctly. MUUUUUUUTH dropped 30.6 and it didn't matter because the rest of your lineup card was written in crayon.

Little Peckers welcomed Aaron Jones to the squad and immediately dropped 144 on OnlyFants, who clocked the league-low 108.22 because ChrisCubby refuses to admit his roster is a Pinterest board. Christian McCalfinjury rode CMC's 39.1 to a 26-point beatdown of Rub My Chubb — though Matt also left Jaxson Dart (29.42) AND Dalton Schultz (23.3) on the bench. Bro you won by 26, you could've won by 78. Speaking of Chubb, Ja'Marr Chase went nuclear for 38.1 and BigD still lost. Welcome to dynasty.

The Good Ladds handled Browning Out behind Jonathan Taylor's 34.2, even though Patrick's Bo Nix went absolute supernova for 39.96 in a losing effort. Mig also flipped picks for Kimani Vidal because Jaydon 3 wasn't enough Jaydons apparently. And McBride's Hock rode his namesake Trey McBride (34.4) to 159.96 over Egbukkake, where szara's Herbert's Butt Buddy posted 28.9 and Erick None lived up to the nickname.

weeklyAwards.blurb: Left 67.64 points on the bench in a 50-point loss — that's not a lineup, that's a hostage situation.

weeklyAwards.title: Participation Ribbon
weeklyAwards.blurb: Bo Nix went for 39.96 and Patrick still found a way to lose by 15 — congrats on the moral 0-fer.

weeklyAwards.title: Demolition Derby Champ
weeklyAwards.blurb: 204.54 points is less a fantasy score and more a felony charge in 38 states.

weeklyAwards.title: Decimal Point Dynasty
weeklyAwards.blurb: Won by 0.86. Don't celebrate, just go change your underwear.
